Not done: signature or trusted-builder verification (none is attached), and GitHub's own attestations for coollabsio/minio (outside this session's reach).

reproduce_minio_rebuild.command: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 golang:1.24-alpine@sha256:8f8959f38530d159bf71d0b3eb0c547dc61e7959d8225d1599cf762477384923 sh -c 'apk add -U --no-cache git >/dev/null && git clone -q https://github.com/minio/minio.git /workspace && cd /workspace && git checkout -q RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/minio/minio/cmd.ReleaseTag=RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z" -o /tmp/minio . && sha256sum /tmp/minio'
reproduce_minio_rebuild.meaning: equal ⇒ the pinned server binary is exactly MinIO's source at the release tag built with the recorded toolchain and flags; different ⇒ not proof of tampering by itself (toolchain image or module drift), compare `go version -m` of both first.

gap_state_effect: MINIO-MIRROR-PROVENANCE-UNVERIFIED-01 stays open. The mc result is a signature over one amd64 binary; the server binary is unproven until the independent rebuild matches. MINIO-IMAGES-DELETED-FROM-DOCKER-HUB-01 (the pull fix) and MINIO-COMMUNITY-EDITION-RECEIVES-NO-SECURITY-FIXES-01 (maintenance) keep their states. The earlier closing condition — the server's sha256 equal to MinIO's published checksum — was the wrong test for a separately compiled binary and was replaced.

ci_verification.job: MinIO server rebuild vs pinned image (linux/amd64)
ci_verification.what_it_does: re-hashes the pinned index bytes against the pin, takes its linux/amd64 entry (sha256:d8cfccee…) and pulls by that digest; extracts /usr/bin/minio and checks it is the measured binary; rebuilds tag RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z (commit 0d7408fc, verified after clone) in the pinned builder with the claimed flags, records go version, go env, git version and `go mod verify`; compares sha256 byte for byte; build info is a supplement.
ci_verification.result_states: match | mismatch | not_measured (with the stage that failed); missing evidence turns a reported comparison into not_measured; never read as success
ci_verification.positive_claim_if_match: The independently rebuilt linux/amd64 MinIO server matches the server extracted from the specified pinned image.
ci_verification.evidence_kept: minio_rebuild_result.json, both build infos, build and pull logs, the raw index, go version/env, git version, go mod verify, both sha256 — uploaded unless the run is cancelled (if-no-files-found: error), 90 days
ci_verification.not_a_gate: contents:read; builds and publishes no image; changes no pin; not one of the 20 required contexts on main (read 2026-10-11) nor in docs/architecture/required_status_checks_contract.json; adds no blocking-surface triple (guard_mutation_guard --blocking-surface: ok). A red run blocks nothing by itself.
